newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg/mark prepares for push towards 2.80.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg/mark prepares for push towards 2.80.

text.p: Sterling is robust in Europe with gains to 2.80 marks likely as the cross draws strength from retaining its foothold above trendline support, said analysts.

But analysts said a break of 2.7975 marks, the week's high, was needed before the cross attacked the 2.80-mark area. At 0715 GMT sterling/mark was trading at 2.7940/45 against 2.7808/13 marks in late Europe on Thursday.
It has managed to remain glued above trendline support from lows at 2.7450 marks on May 13 to 2.7700 marks on May 15, which now cuts in at around 2.7860 marks.
Against the dollar, sterling was also buoyed.
At 0735 GMT cable was trading at $1.6415/20 against $1.6384/94 in late Europe, with the pair consolidating before attempting to scale new peaks.
The fact cable spiked above previous peaks of $1.6478 on Thursday and closed above the $1.64 level was seen by chartists as positive.
"Cable is steady above $1.6340...look for a push to $1.66 later," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank.
Analysts, however, said cable would need to hold above $1.6365, Thursday's lows, for fresh upside momentum.
